ogiso.title: Ogiso et al., Cell 2002
ogiso.supports: 2:2 EGF–EGFR ectodomain complex; ligand between I/III and domain-II receptor contact
ogiso.reading: Primary abstract and record; diagram uses schematic domain regions, not a structural reconstruction.

zhang.title: Zhang et al., Cell 2006
zhang.supports: Asymmetric kinase-domain dimer activation of EGFR
zhang.reading: Primary abstract and author-hosted PDF summary; tail phosphorylation is represented as an aggregate state, not a symmetric kinase mechanism.

grb2.title: Li et al. and Rozakis-Adcock et al., Nature 1993
grb2.supports: GRB2 SH2 receptor-pY binding and SH3 association with SOS proline-rich region
grb2.reading: Both primary abstracts; preassembled GRB2–SOS association is retained in the model.

sos.title: Boriack-Sjodin et al., Nature 1998
sos.supports: SOS-induced nucleotide release and rebinding in RAS
sos.reading: Primary abstract and figure index; no atomic contact geometry reproduced.

rasraf.title: Warne et al., Nature 1993
rasraf.reading: Primary abstract; binding and later RAF activation are separate events.

rafreg.title: Rajakulendran et al., Nature 2009
rafreg.supports: Dimerization-dependent RAF catalytic activation; this regulatory assembly is collapsed in the core diagram.
rafreg.reading: Primary abstract; Drosophila S2 RAF and oncogenic BRAF contexts. Omitted regulators are also mapped in the linked review.

mekerK.title: Crews et al., Science and PNAS 1992
mekerK.supports: MEK phosphorylates and activates ERK with threonine/tyrosine recognition
mekerK.reading: Primary abstracts; dual phospho state shown as pT/pY, without residue numbers.

visual.title: BioRender public Simplified MAPK/ERK signalling preview
visual.supports: Visual comparison: compartment bands, sparse silhouettes, external labels and cascade flow
visual.reading: Public preview viewed in browser. Its source art is neither traced nor embedded in the output.
